art_note: Clean studio product shots, but the model imagery relies on artificial compositing which diminishes the luxury presentation.
desc_en: This piece reinterprets resort elegance with a refined and feminine silhouette. Crafted from a soft and stretchy technical fabric, it features a flattering ruched front design that adds texture and movement. The square neckline is structured by contrasting fixed shoulder straps, creating a graphic and modern aesthetic. Engineered to deliver absolute comfort and a seamless fit in any aquatic setting. Made to order. Worldwide shipping available.
desc_es: Esta pieza reinterpreta la elegancia balnearia con una silueta depurada y femenina. Confeccionado en un tejido técnico elástico y suave, presenta un favorecedor diseño frontal fruncido que aporta textura y movimiento. El escote cuadrado se estructura mediante finos tirantes fijos en contraste, creando una estética gráfica y moderna. Diseñado para ofrecer un confort absoluto y un ajuste impecable en cualquier entorno acuático. Made to order. Worldwide shipping available.
details_en:
· 86% polyester, 14% spandex
